description.subtitle: England 2026 Nike Pre-Match Warm-Up Top - Gray
description.intro: The Nike England Pre-Match Dri-FIT Academy Pro 2026 jersey is part of the exclusive collaboration between Nike and Palace for the English national team. Its elegant gray design incorporates subtle graphics inspired by Palace's creative universe, combined with red details that provide personality and character. An exclusive garment that fuses football, urban fashion and the identity of the Three Lions.
key_benefits: Dri-FIT Technology: Helps wick away sweat to keep skin dry.
Nike x Palace collaboration: Exclusive design inspired by British streetwear culture.
Light fabric: Promotes comfort during warm-up.
Official England Crest: Show your passion for the Three Lions.

source.intro: La camiseta Nike Inglaterra Pre-Match Dri-FIT Academy Pro 2026 forma parte de la exclusiva colaboración entre Nike y Palace para la selección inglesa. Su elegante diseño en color gris incorpora gráficos sutiles inspirados en el universo creativo de Palace, combinados con detalles en rojo que aportan personalidad y carácter. Una prenda exclusiva que fusiona fútbol, moda urbana y la identidad de los Three Lions.
key_benefits: Tecnología Dri-FIT: Ayuda a evacuar el sudor para mantener la piel seca.
Colaboración Nike x Palace: Diseño exclusivo inspirado en la cultura streetwear británica.
Tejido ligero: Favorece la comodidad durante el calentamiento.
Escudo oficial de Inglaterra: Muestra tu pasión por los Three Lions.
